WHEN STEPS CAN BE SKIPPED: closed machine-verifiable domains (code, formal logic, theorem proving) have a compiler/proof-checker that IS an intact target, so preference tuning is genuinely skippable and RL against execution or verification replaces it; open non-formalizable domains (ethics, dialogue, coordination) have NO verifier, so ledger-plus-search is INSUFFICIENT not merely more expensive. REPAIR: the ledger's job is not to be the target but to make the target NON-GAMEABLE -- to stop a system retroactively rewriting what it did in order to claim success; provenance is a GUARD ON the objective, not a substitute for it.
